description: Add an on-screen title from plain text using a stock Essential Graphics template that ships with Premiere (default: Basic Title). Pass text for one line, or lines to fill the template's text fields in order (for example a lower third's name and role). Premiere-built templates (kind 'premiere') get the text baked into a verified copy of the template before import, because Premiere exposes no writable text for them (textVerification 'template_verified'; confirm the render with export_frame). After Effects-built templates (kind 'after_effects') are imported and their text fields written by position and read back from Premiere (textVerification 'verified', 'mismatch', 'missing_property', or 'committed_unverified'). The graphic is trimmed to duration_seconds and its length read back. Use list_stock_titles to see templates, their kind, and how many lines each takes.

duration_seconds.description: How long the title stays on screen in seconds (default: 5).

lines.description: Text for each of the template's text fields in order (see list_stock_titles). Specify exactly one of text or lines.

template.description: Stock template name such as "Basic Title", "Bold Title", or "Basic Lower Third", or category/name such as "Titles/Bold Title" (default: Basic Title).

text.description: Title text for the first text field. Specify exactly one of text or lines.

track_index.description: Zero-based video track for the graphic (default: 1, the track above the main footage).

name: add_title

data.description: Tool-specific result data when ok is true; on failure, diagnostic detail when the tool provides it.

error.description: Failure detail when ok is false.

title: Add Title
